project: Kinetic — A thought becomes a world
promise: Kinetic turns one small thought into a world with shape, rhythm, and room to move.

type_direction.display: Fraunces variable (optical size set to rendered size, weight 550–720)
type_direction.line_break_principle: large, quiet display phrase; one short supporting line; labels secondary and legible at phone scale

beats.action: A single warm point travels and draws the reveal mask under the phrase; the first line is fully readable before the second beat.
The same filament curves into a route; the moving point and a left-to-right mask travel together, not as an unrelated wipe.
Three words arrive in a deliberate stagger on a restrained baseline; a travelling point lands on each word and changes its emphasis.
The drawn route folds into an open frame; a light seam sweeps through the same typographic position, replacing thought with world.
The outlined frame opens past the safe margins and resolves into generous typographic space; palette inverts from ink to paper, with cool light.
Paper recedes into night; two lines enter at different scales and settle on one shared baseline as the warm point finds the period.
The moving line resolves into an original three-stroke K monogram, then the wordmark locks to its right.
A clean end frame holds long enough to read; final light has a designed low, steady phase rather than a fade to black.
